meta.title: Dutch with "Offers on Total Amount" hides the closing condition

steps.note: Start the RFQ required before conversion to a Dutch auction.
Create an RFQ stage that can be converted to an auction.
Apply the RFQ template before adding line items.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Add the required participant before publishing.
Publish the RFQ so it can be converted.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real project page.
Open the conversion create screen where Dutch auction configuration is available.

args.goal: On the converted auction create screen, select the Dutch auction strategy, choose “Offers on Total Amount”, and stop on the configuration screen showing that the closing-condition selector is not rendered.

steps.note: Perform the Dutch-specific selection and verify the closing-condition control is hidden, which no catalog domain step can configure directly.
Confirm the resulting configuration screen has no rendering or application errors.
